comments.body: 2026-11-13: the Codex half is green on Codex 0.167.2 - all nine ./dev --codex checks pass after 97d242f4 (the hookless pane disables the installed plugin for its process) and 5632000e (the collector waits for the current turn). The idle-message round trip passed before any change. The Claude Code half is still open.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description:
**Wanted:** `./dev --claude-code` and `./dev --codex` pass. On 2026-11-06 they gave 11 passed, 2 failed and 7 passed, 2 failed, and the same four tests failed with and without the 0.23.0 context-change work. The other live checks passed, including the new ones for context changes.

- `claude_code_doorbell::an_urgent_post_reaches_claude_code_mid_turn` expects `woke: worker (working)`. The post now prints `woke: <callsign> (worker, working)`, so the assertion is out of date.
- `claude_code_doorbell::a_brief_posted_to_a_new_claude_pane_is_rung_read_whole_and_answered`: the worker never answered.
- `codex_live::a_message_posted_to_an_idle_codex_pane_is_rung_read_and_answered`: the worker never answered.
- `codex_live::codex_reads_working_then_idle_through_its_hooks_and_through_its_screen`: the pane with no hooks read as reporting. The cause may be an adapter installed for this user, which nobody checked.

**Not diagnosed:** the last three. The Codex runs used 0.166.0 through a `PATH` override, with `MUSTER_CODEX_MODEL=gpt-6.1-terra`, because Homebrew's Codex 0.167 can't run commands on the machine that measured this.
title: Four live-tier checks fail on Claude Code and Codex
